findings.what_happened: The assistant concluded that the claim was supported, failing to recognize that the claim asserts Sports Collectors Digest is 'quarterly', whereas Passage [3] explicitly states it is a 'weekly' publication. A quarterly publication (4 issues per year) would actually publish less frequently than a bimonthly publication like The Wittenburg Door (6 issues per year), directly refuting the claim.
findings.quote: The evidence is sufficient to confirm that Sports Collectors Digest (weekly) publishes more frequently than The Wittenburg Door (bimonthly), and that Ole Anthony was the editor of the latter.
